name: Stylized signature design tutorials
what_it_is: Close-up handwriting videos showing how to draw stylized cursive signatures and monograms, usually for a specific initial or pair of initials (V, DH, K, R, M, KC, etc.), drawn with pens, pencils, or fountain pens on paper. Some clips are fountain-pen calligraphy showcases of flowing "style signatures" rather than step-by-step tutorials.
